mapper.select: select * from `user` where userAccount=#{account} and isDelete=0
select * from `user` where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
mapper.update: update `user` set userName=#{name},userAvatar=#{avatar},userProfile=#{profile},editTime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
update `user` set userName=#{name},userRole=#{role},editTime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and isDelete=0

mapper.select: select * order by id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
